searchText: also <@755590043632140352> you do have #5222 implemented **but only** if you process the block `beacon-chain/blockchain/process_block.go:650-659` ```go for _, att := range atts { root := bytesutil.ToBytes32(att.Data.BeaconBlockRoot) if !s.cfg.ForkChoiceStore.HasNode(root) { continue } for i := range committee { if att.AggregationBits.BitAt(uint64(i)) { s.cfg.ForkChoiceStore.SetPTCVote(root, uint64(i), att.Data.PayloadPresent, att.Data.BlobDataAvailable) } } } ``` this solves the mystery, due to the fact that `deathstar` is packing ptc votes, prysm correctly counts them when processing the block per #5222 however prysm doesn't follow #5222 when - (1) processing ptc attestations from gossip - (2) and when prysm is producing blocks, you are not setting the aggregate bits correctly I will patch `deathstar` tomorrow to not pack ptc attestations that vote against it's own payload reorg, we should then see prysm being a `deathstar` supporter I haven't merged 5222 yet on the devnet branch no, but prysm on `develop` already has it implemented when you process a block, seems like it was done 3 motnhs ago To pass tests 🙂 Oh no on blocks it was always needed but if prysm is proposer you don't even set hte aggregate bits correctly lol Yeah we can fix that this just works because other proposers like lodestar, teku, lighthouse set it correctly It shouldn't be much problem, it's just silly to case this 🙂 I am happy to have figured it out so fine either way at least I know now why prysm votes correctly, need to make `deathstar` bit smarter to not pack the evidence into the block it proposes but locally prysm vote counts are all over the place in a small devnet with low validator count as it depends on who is the proposer, which is super confusing if you look the the v2 fork choice dumps Thanks for looking into this so detailed simple reproduction locally ```yaml participants_matrix: el: - excerpts.author: nflaig
excerpts.content:
simple reproduction locally
```yaml
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: nethermind
      el_image: ethpandaops/nethermind:glamsterdam-devnet-5
  cl:
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:deathstar # <-- reorgs timely payloads, no longer packs PTC attestations
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:glamsterdam-devnet-5-699d0f4 # <-- faulty lodestar that supports deathstar
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:glamsterdam-devnet-5 # <-- lodestar that works per spec
    - cl_type: prysm
      cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:glamsterdam-devnet-5 # <-- prysm supports deathstar blocks
network_params:
  preset: mainnet
  gloas_fork_epoch: 1

global_log_level: info

additional_services:
  - dora
```
